tips.text: Buy extra Handle relics; the build needs 2 Handles and every one carries it as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Bank Aya before her window opens; it never expires when her stock rotates.
Run the Rare relics as a Radiant radshare, and refine only Rare and Uncommon relics.
Leave the Common Blueprint relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you still get the part and they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
